A block marker on a continuation line of multiline alt text is escaped

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<img alt=\"Alpha\n-\nBeta\" src=\"image.png\">", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
